subtitle: Verified native iPhone companion builds
description: Update-only AltStore Classic feed for the Bug-Bounty PC companion. This feed contains compiled unsigned IPA builds and public metadata only.

apps.name: Bug-Bounty
apps.subtitle: Native companion for Bug-Bounty Mission Control
apps.localizedDescription: Connects to an explicitly started Bug-Bounty PC bridge on your trusted local network. View live work, reports, guidelines and campaigns; create local drafts; ask one configured model about supplied text; and run the benign evidence-review benchmark. The phone cannot execute targets, start hunts, expose provider credentials, approve outbound content or submit reports.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes empty and timed-out sections with independent loading, visible connection recovery and QR re-pairing. Adds an explicit supplied-text assistant and the benign evidence-review benchmark using models configured on the PC.
Adds secure QR pairing, a native Mission Control app icon, and the complete paired companion experience.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan the one-time pairing QR code shown by your Bug-Bounty PC.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connect securely to your explicitly started Bug-Bounty companion bridge on this PC.
